title: Network
summary: Find out why the hotspot or the link misbehaves with no internet to apt from: iperf3, mtr, iw, wavemon, dig, tcpdump, WireGuard's tools.
consent: tcpdump reads every packet on the box; iperf3 listens for a test partner. Install the kit only while you need it.
notes: nftables and iw come with the box itself (install.sh); this kit adds what one reaches for when the radio or the link is the question.
iperf3 -s on the box and iperf3 -c <the box> on a phone or laptop measures the hotspot's real throughput.
wavemon shows the link's signal and rate as it changes; iw dev <iface> station dump lists each guest's.
